capability.summary: Run Flake8 on one Python file or directory and return its raw textual findings in a JSON envelope
capability.description: Validates the target path and executes `flake8 <target>` without formatter or fix flags. Flake8 may discover its normal project configuration; findings remain unparsed text in `stdout`, and source files are never modified.
capability.problem_space: Read-only Flake8 style and static lint diagnostics for Python files or directories; not formatting, automatic fixing, Bandit security scanning, Ruff-specific linting, or structured finding normalization.

constraint.io_signature: Input: one required existing Python file or directory path; output: JSON process envelope containing Flake8's raw text stdout/stderr and exit code.
accepted_inputs: an existing Python source file path
an existing directory path for Flake8 traversal
constraint.output_shape: Completed lint (Flake8 exit 0 or 1): {status: "success", tool: "flake8", target: string, exit_code: 0|1, result: null, stdout: string, stderr: string|null}; exit 0 means no reported violations and exit 1 means findings, whose standard Flake8 lines remain in stdout. Other exits use the same keys with status="tool_error" and propagate the actual exit code. Missing target/executable/120-second timeout: {status: "error", tool: "flake8", message: string}, exiting 2/3/4. Missing argument prints usage to stderr and exits 1 without JSON.
limitations: does not request native JSON or parse Flake8 lines, so result is null and findings are unstructured stdout text inside the outer JSON envelope
does not fix, format, or rewrite Python code and offers no caller-selectable Flake8 flags, plugins, ignores, or thresholds
Flake8's normal configuration discovery and installed plugin set can affect results
requires `flake8` on PATH, uses a fixed 120-second timeout, and captures output without truncation

output_contract.description: JSON execution envelope with Flake8's exit code and raw unparsed text findings in stdout; result remains null and files are unchanged.

json_schema.description: Native JSON representation only; no field or task-delivery guarantee.

intent_tags: collect Flake8 textual diagnostics for a file or directory
negative_intents: format Python with Black or automatically fix lint violations
run Ruff-specific lint rules or return structured Ruff JSON
scan Python code for Bandit security vulnerabilities

output_contract.description: JSON execution envelope with Flake8's exit code and raw unparsed text findings in stdout; result remains null and files are unchanged.

json_schema.description: Native JSON representation only; no field or task-delivery guarantee.
